title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Delegation Schedule: Goodwill Authority by Storage Statement Size
content:
**Delegation.** For storage goodwill on a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking, the goodwill authority follows the size of the storage statement charge:

| Storage statement charge | Goodwill authority |
|---|---|
| At least 1,000.00 USD (1000) | 250.00 USD |
| At least 500.00 USD (500) but under 1,000.00 USD | 150.00 USD |
| Under 500.00 USD | not raised by this delegation |

A storage statement charge of at least 1000 USD carries an authority of 250 USD; one of at least 500 USD but under 1000 USD carries 150 USD; a smaller one is not given a raised authority by this delegation.

**Both sides of each threshold** (hypothetical statement amounts)

- 1,000.00 USD — at least 1,000.00: 250.00 USD.
- 999.99 USD — under 1,000.00 but at least 500.00: 150.00 USD.
- 500.00 USD — at least 500.00: 150.00 USD.
- 499.99 USD — under 500.00: no raised authority.

The size is that of the storage statement charge itself, as posted on the booking — not of the booking's other charges.
